CONTAINER_CRITERIA = ("G3", "G4", "decomp-shape") — so G3/G4 now also take the children-required branch

advisory.finding: The eval_solver container arm now requires a `children` list, but the existing G3/G4 calibration fixtures (plan-review-container.eval.yaml) encode the container scenario entirely in the `input` prose field with no `children:` list. Running `rebar criteria eval G3` (or G4) will now raise 'container criterion needs a non-empty `children` list' — the existing G3/G4 fixtures are incompatible with the new container-arm path this change introduces.
scenarios: A maintainer runs `rebar criteria eval G3` to calibrate coverage detection and gets a children-missing fixture error

advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] Replace the prose-token assertions in test_prompt_contract_front_matter with structural front-matter/routing checks (or drop them), since the grepped tokens are LLM-consumed prose, not a parser contract.
evidence: tests/unit/test_decomp_shape_criterion.py:84: `assert "ADVISORY" in body and "does NOT block" in body`

The grepped tokens live in the prompt body of src/rebar/llm/reviewers/plan_review_decomp_shape.md, which is consumed by the LLM at review time, not by a parser — per the false-positive guard an LLM is not a non-human consumer, so a prose grep here is a wording change-detector.
advisory.finding: test_prompt_contract_front_matter asserts free-text prose tokens ('LAYER-CAKE', 'CONSUMED-ARTIFACT-WITHOUT-ORDERING-EDGE', 'ADVISORY', 'does NOT block') are present in the LLM-consumed reviewer prompt body. The only consumer of that prose is the LLM (not a parser/validator), so these assertions guard the author's wording and would break on a behavior-preserving rewording of the rubric without any observable-behavior change — a change-detector aspect. (The front-matter key assertions in the same test — execution_mode/dimension/category — are parser-consumed and valid.)
scenarios: A future rewording of the rubric that preserves the two smells but renames the headings (e.g. 'HORIZONTAL-LAYER SPLIT') breaks the test without any behavior change.
